claims.object_text: C57BL/6- Kcnt1 em1Bryd carrying the G269S variant
claims.quote: generated a novel mouse model (C57BL/6- Kcnt1 em1Bryd ) carrying the G269S variant

claims.object_text: sustained hyperexcitability and hypersynchronous bursting in cultured cortical neurons
claims.quote: Network excitability of cultured cortical neurons from Kcnt1 +/G269S exhibited sustained hyperexcitability and hypersynchronous bursting

claims.object_text: early excessive bursting followed by network collapse suggesting excitotoxicity
claims.quote: Kcnt1 G269S/G269S neurons showed early excessive bursting followed by network collapse, suggesting excitotoxicity.

claims.object_text: poor motor coordination; erratic breathing; increased apneas
claims.quote: Kcnt1 +/G269S displayed poor motor coordination, erratic breathing, and increased apneas.
Kcnt1 +/G269S were more susceptible to thermal-induced seizures in early life.
Gain-of-function mutations in the sodium-gated potassium channel KCNT1 have been linked to pediatric epilepsy of varying severity.

claims.object_text: Autosomal Dominant Nocturnal Frontal Lobe Epilepsy (ADNFLE); Epilepsy of Infancy with Migrating Focal Seizures (EIMFS); severe developmental epileptic encephalopathies
claims.quote: The human KCNT1 variant G288S (G269S in mice) is linked to Autosomal Dominant Nocturnal Frontal Lobe Epilepsy (ADNFLE), Epilepsy of Infancy with Migrating Focal Seizures (EIMFS), and other severe developmental epileptic encephalopathies.
